+    {"id":"Q46","answer":"No. Show the encounter card to all players when drawn, show its artwork, and read the capitalized thematic text aloud. You need not read every option aloud.","support":"supported","evidence":"Encounters: card disclosure instruction"},
+    {"id":"Q47","answer":"No limit applies to friendly units or resource tokens on a territory.","support":"supported","evidence":"Control, resources and home bases"},

+    {"id":"Q49","answer":"No. The chosen top and bottom actions are each limited to once within the turn, including for Rusviet; Rusviet's repeat ability only waives the previous-turn section restriction.","support":"supported","evidence":"Turn Structure Rusviet qualification"},
+    {"id":"Q50","answer":"The normal unupgraded Move action lets you choose the alternative of gaining $1 instead of moving units.","support":"supported","evidence":"Move OR coins"},

+    {"id":"Q52","answer":"Yes. You may attack with zero power and/or zero popularity.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat introduction"},
+    {"id":"Q53","answer":"Yes. You may still fight after reaching your combat-star limit; the ordinary maximum is two combat stars (Saxony has no usual limit within six available).","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat step 5"},
+    {"id":"Q54","answer":"No to declining all choice: a faction without Meander must choose one affordable option. It cannot select an unaffordable coin/popularity option. +    {"id":"Q55","answer":"No turn-order selection: combatants simultaneously and secretly choose dial power (and optionally cards). Reveal simultaneously after selection.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat steps 1–3"},
+    {"id":"Q56","answer":"Announce the bottom-row action so neighbors can check recruit bonuses.","support":"supported","evidence":"Bottom-row actions introductory paragraph"},
+    {"id":"Q57","answer":"A star is placed as soon as its goal is achieved and cannot be declined or delayed to avoid ending the game. +    {"id":"Q58","answer":"Normally no: units cannot cross rivers or enter lakes. A river is between two land territories and a lake is a whole hex; faction and mech abilities provide exceptions.","support":"supported","evidence":"Move: river/lake restriction"},
+    {"id":"Q59","answer":"No. The recruit is permanently placed on the chosen one-time bonus and cannot later move.","support":"supported","evidence":"Enlist: ‘It cannot later move’"},
+    {"id":"Q60","answer":"No. Only a character triggers an encounter; it stops on entering the token territory. Mechs and workers do not trigger/remove the token by entering.","support":"supported","evidence":"Encounters: ‘Only a character triggers an encounter’"},
+    {"id":"Q61","answer":"A controlled Mill adds one bonus production territory in addition to the normal allowance: two normal territories become up to three, or upgraded allowance three becomes up to four. +    {"id":"Q63","answer":"Build is paid with wood; Enlist is paid with food.","support":"supported","evidence":"Bottom-row actions: ‘Build — wood’ and ‘Enlist — food’"}
+  ]
+}
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
